question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The **correct answer** is 'Option 2** (Ornage)'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Ornage'** is incorrectly spelt. 
 
• The right spelling is '**Orange'. **
 
• **'Orange'** relates to a type of citrus fruit or the colour that resembles this fruit. (नारंगी)

Consequently, the **correct answer** is :*'Option 2 (Ornage)'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 **'Famous'**, meaning well-known, is correctly spelled. (प्रसिद्ध)
 
• Option 3** 'Leader', **meaning someone who leads, is correctly spelled.(नेता)
 
• Option 4 **'Flowing',** which pertains to something moving in a steady and continuous way like water, is also correctly spelled. (बहता हुआ)
